acceptance_dimensions.silhouette_exterior_identity: Atlas orange production bands, numbered cell crowns and a marked manual-control spine turn the fabrication plant into a standardized assembly hall
acceptance_dimensions.interior_zoning_circulation: feed staging, four assembly cells, inspection/rework, manual-bypass corridor and outbound handling form a readable production sequence
acceptance_dimensions.functional_machinery_props: press/depot stations, drive casings, calibration stock and dedicated bypass pedestals make automated handling physically legible
acceptance_dimensions.institutional_identity: Atlas numbered orange cells and black/yellow lockout stations standardize both normal automation and emergency intervention
acceptance_dimensions.historical_damage_signature: the final cell runs under a conspicuous manual bypass with stripped automation and staged replacement casings during active containment
acceptance_dimensions.narrative_evidence_loot: guaranteed manual-bypass notice shows Old World automation remaining productive only through increasingly desperate human intervention
